status: Local freeze after synthetic/native contracts and image-directory metadata only, before new image-member reads, detector outputs or control execution. Known four old numerical failures/five old assignment cases disclosed. Not external preregistration.

definitions.selection: Next two KITTI training IDs in lexical order after all previously used0000-0005, fixed0006/0007 full270/800 original frames. No new output inspected before freeze.0004/0005 are seen mechanism checks only, never independent confirmation. New IDs are source-held-out relative to rule design, same dataset/camera family; no independent site/person/randomized sample claim. Inspect every scheduled source, keep zeros/failures, no replacements/windows/retries or favourable selection.
definitions.preparation: Official image-only archive, immutable ETag/ranges, full ordered PNG CRC/member manifest, SHA256 and FFV1 bgr0 pixel equality at original10Hz. All frames, no resize/crop/resampling. Frozen YOLO26n/8.4.176 CPU person cache at confidence.1,640px,max64,NMS.7; original weights hash, no tuning. Reject cap frames for acceptance but retain counts/source. No labels archive/member/GT/evaluator is accepted by schemas or read.
definitions.rule: At each native fixed-step predict, compute prospective mean F(1)*x on positive finite XYXY prestate. If prospective width<=0 or height<=0, independently project the two affected corner velocities to their arithmetic average: T is I8 except both corresponding velocity rows contain .5 in those two velocity columns. x_projected=T*x; P_projected=T*P*T.T including all cross terms, then call unchanged native predict with original F/Q/H/R. No position clamp, epsilon, fitted duration, detector/input/solver/gate/lifetime change. No change when no axis triggers. Both axes can trigger once. The conditional linear projection propagates moments for the selected T; it does not calibrate uncertainty over branch selection.
definitions.state_consistency: Apply identical projection to live estimator and persistent detached shadow before original predict. Original shadow checks every dtype/shape/value/byte-hash before/after every native predict and accepted update, exact F*x/F*P*F.T+Q, P/Q/R symmetry/PSD screens fixed1e-10. Keep state_post/P_post as last actual accepted update; native predict writes new state_prior/P_prior; no rewriting historical posterior, motion/noise caches or clocks. Unsupported nonpositive prestate in treatment fails, never repaired; reference allows native invalid means. Finite failures retained as failure, not exclusion.
definitions.accepted_and_roles: All tentative/confirmed hypotheses use the same guard, active pre-predict time_since_update0 versus retained>0 separately counted. No waiting/maturity change. Original high/weak association and Kalman measurement update execute unchanged, once with original measurement. Never project, clip, reject or reroute an accepted update or rewrite its posterior. A nonpositive accepted posterior fails the scene screen. Preserve all weak inputs, weak-stage execution, native births/confirmation and expiry. Effects on actual accepted observations are measured, not assumed unchanged.
definitions.reference_seal: Before ANY control execution, run unhooked native reference on every source and seal complete prediction JSON/native-output/final-state hashes plus immutable input locks. Old0004/0005 JSON bytes/native outputs/final-state equal original archive; new0006/0007 native references are newly sealed, not historical originals. Two full observed reference passes/source must equal those native byte/state seals, old lifecycle also equals original seal. Two control passes/source must equal each other in complete output, final state, lifecycle, numerical and projection histories and event sets. Fresh isolated process per pass, OpenCV one thread/seed0, no inference during tracking.
definitions.proxy_harm_per_scene: No pooling across scenes. Every treatment must have zero numerical-screen failures, zero nonpositive predicted/accepted posterior rows, zero lost baseline weak accepted input events(frame,input-index), zero lost baseline confirmed-output input events, zero lost baseline active accepted update pairs(frame,birth-frame,birth-input-index,current-input-index,stage), and zero new birth events(frame,input-index). Lineage is shared input birth key, not transfer/equality of native ID numbers. Lost/new sets, not only count differences. Additional confirmed input events recorded as unverified, not benefits/false positives. Treatment failure or reference mismatch blocks acceptance. These conservative observable proxies cannot establish FP/FN/IDSW/HOTA, correct identity or true harm without GT.
definitions.exposure_gate: Each of BOTH new full sources must complete all passes, have >=1 actual projected row and strictly fewer nonpositive prediction rows than its own native reference, no detection-cap frames and every per-scene proxy-harm gate true. A zero-trigger source has no effective exposure; it cannot pass replication by equality. Mechanism checks reported separately; no source may compensate another. Even passing this gate is geometry/proxy acceptance only; tracking quality/harm remains unverified and defaults stay unchanged.
definitions.publication: Only fixed source-level aggregate counts, each scene gate/result including zeros/failures and whole-source input/output/code/runtime hashes. Raw states/covariances/matrices, selected axes per case, frame/IDs/birth keys/events, costs, paths, media, labels and diagnostics stay in ignored local artifacts. No inference caches, source images, private data or model weights in public manifest.
